name.baseName: Natural gas, high pressure, at consumer

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Infrastructure requirements are based on estimated standard capacity. The net calorific value of natural gas is 36.0 MJ/Nm³. UUID=dd89282f-84c6-338b-9dbe-628c99d3a3c3

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Energy requirements are from 2019 and leakage data are from 2018. Trade movements investigated for 2023.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Energy requirements and emissions are based on Swiss data. Calculations include production and transport of natural gas from 42 countries.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
The quantity of gas delivered in the high pressure network is estimated. Industry, power plants and half of commercial and of other sectors are assumed to consume high pressure gas.

# Included processes
This dataset describes the structure of the Global gas mix with regard to the countries of origin and the energy requirements and the emissions of the high pressure distribution network.
